name: get_campaign_report
title: Campaign report
description:
The report of one launched campaign: contacted, replied, booked and the goal; how each card's outcomes
came out; meetings and who booked each; opt-outs by how; spend at the workspace's price; a day-by-day
series; and, with `split_by`, the same split by one column of the list. A draft has no report.

split_by.description: A column of the campaign's list to split the results by. Its values come from the customer list, so this needs the "Read conversation messages" permission.
